meta.description: Contracting Parties to the UNECE 1958 Agreement (countries only) and, per country, which of the lighting-related UN Regulations R3, R6, R7, R23, R38, R48, R148, R149, R150 they apply; plus selected non-1958 markets (CHN, USA, CAN, IND, BRA) with a national-regulation profile.

meta.notes: Party list: UN Treaty Collection XI-B-16 lists 62 parties = 61 countries + the European Union (accession 23 Jan 1998). The EU is not included as a country entry; it has approval code E 42 and per WP.29/343 'approvals are granted by its Member States using their respective ECE symbol'. EU member states are listed individually: 24 of them are parties in their own right; Ireland (E 24), Cyprus (E 49) and Malta (E 50) are NOT individual parties in the UN Treaty Collection but appear in WP.29/343/Rev.34/Add.1 with dates of application 'by virtue of' EU accession, so they are included with regime unece_1958 and an explanatory note. applied_regulations: lists ONLY which of the nine checked lighting regulations (UN R3, R6, R7, R23, R38, R48, R148, R149, R150) have a 'date of application' for that Contracting Party in ECE/TRANS/WP.29/343/Rev.34/Add.1 (distr. 10 March 2026, extracted from the official .docx on 2026-10-25); it is not a statement about other UN Regulations. R148 (light-signalling lamps), R149 (road illumination) and R150 (retro-reflective devices) entered into force 15/11/2019; several Contracting Parties (KAZ, AZE, AND, KOR, THA, TUN) apply only these and not the older R3/R6/R7/R23/R38/R48. Cambodia (accession 3 Feb 2026) and Mongolia (accession 29 Apr 2026) are not yet in Rev.34/Add.1, so their applied_regulations are 'unverified'. Viet Nam declared that it is not bound by any annexed UN Regulation, hence an empty list. North Macedonia: UN R48 applied for category O only per a note in Rev.34/Add.1, so R48 omitted for passenger-car use. Later notifications after 10 March 2026 (e.g. informal updates of the status document) were not checked. CHN, USA, CAN, IND and BRA are not 1958 Contracting Parties per the UN Treaty Collection; they have regime 'national', an empty applied_regulations list and a profile file in data/country_profiles/.
